basis: Against its own July guide (moderate sales growth, break-even to positive adj. EBITDA ex-refund, net debt near $5M) Q1 came in ahead on every line: sales +6.5% with bedding +13%, adj. EBITDA $566k, net debt $3.1M, FCF $7.8M. The Q2 break-even operating-income guide continues the trend; the tariff refund itself was pre-announced.
